title: Compare paragraph readings
subtitle: Use repeated grammar to compare, not to collapse, distinct texts.
overview: Comparing passages can sharpen observation when each paragraph has first been read independently. Compare wording, grammar, placement, and discourse role.
Do not harmonize distinct authors by default. A difference may be stylistic, contextual, or structurally significant; record it before explaining it.
